metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Romance Cover
useCases: Soul and Motown era aesthetic projects

retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style graphic layout featuring a central large heart, floating secondary hearts, and a female silhouette against a streetlamp, utilizing bold italicized display type and casual script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition dominated by a large blue heart containing centered script text, flanked by a female silhouette leaning against a streetlamp and a cluster of red hearts floating on a cream background with a black diagonal base.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central blue heart as the primary container for the title
Female silhouette integrated with a vertical streetlamp element on the right
Ascending cluster of red hearts on the left creating upward movement
Bold italicized name at the top spanning the width of the frame
Diagonal black ground plane providing a stable base for the silhouette
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all primary heart shapes
Flat, unshaded color fields for red, blue, and cream
High-contrast black silhouette for the figure and streetlamp

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large blue heart centered; large italicized text at the top; silhouette at 3/4 height on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue heart serves as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top bold text, moves down to the blue heart, follows the silhouette's vertical line, and circles back through the floating red hearts.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Cream-colored background provides breathing room around the dense central and top elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid Black for silhouettes and outlines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red and Medium Blue for heart shapes
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation accents against a neutral, low-value background with high-contrast black elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy italic sans-serif and casual upright script
letterConstructionRules: Top display text uses extreme right-leaning italics with thick strokes
Central script features rounded terminals and connected lowercase letters
Secondary text uses clean, geometric sans-serif capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'W' in the top display text feature sharp, aggressive angles
Script 'Y' and 'L' have elongated, fluid descenders and ascenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, heavy italic sans-serif paired with a friendly, casual upright script for contrast between power and romance.

preserve: Italic angle of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and aggressive slant of the top display text.
Captures the mid-century casual script feel for the central title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cream background with a black diagonal wedge at the bottom right. Place a large blue heart in the center and several red hearts of varying sizes floating on the left. Add a black silhouette of a woman leaning against a streetlamp on the right side, partially overlapping the blue heart.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main artist name in a heavy black italic sans-serif at the top. Place the title in a white script with a black outline, centered inside the blue heart. Add secondary track info in a small red heart at the bottom left using a clean sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the top text heavily italicized?
Is the central text a script font with a black outline?
Are the hearts solid flat colors with black borders?
Is the silhouette solid black without internal detail?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the bottom black diagonal
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between black silhouettes and bright colors

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue heart is the largest shape
Check that the silhouette is purely black
Verify the top text is the most dominant typographic element
Confirm the background is a warm cream rather than pure white
Check that all hearts have consistent black stroke weights
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large central geometric container with a silhouette character and a cluster of secondary motifs, topped with heavy slanted display type.
